label: G1a-independent-role-synthesis
prompt: You are an INDEPENDENT senior AI-systems architect giving a BLIND second opinion. Do NOT assume any predetermined answer. GROUND (facts): 'Yuri' is a personal AI assistant for a solo technical founder (Marcel). Brain = GLM-5.2 (z.ai) at localhost:8014; LIVE voice loop (mic→Whisper→GLM→Kokoro); computer-use screen-reader (macOS AX tree) DISARMED; memory = episodic FTS5 + a behavioral memory file. She is intended as the FRONT-END to a large personal AI-OS (fleet dispatch, trading engine, memory, parallel coding sessions). The operator is a mastermind who wants to 'think and speak and have it get done', across several parallel sessions, with overnight unattended runs. His explicit fear: OVER-ENGINEERING. A second operator (his father) independently wants a near-identical assistant framed as COO-to-his-CEO. TASK: Produce YOUR OWN definitive answer to 'what is Yuri's ROLE, and what is the SOLID-BUT-MINIMAL setup to make that role real?' Cover: (1) one-sentence role statement, (2) the operating contract (who decides/executes vs organizes/proposes), (3) the confirm-gate threshold, (4) the memory policy, (5) activation + the daily loop, (6) top-5 improvements ranked by leverage, (7) an explicit CUT list of what NOT to build. Be opinionated and concrete. This is a blind independent take whose DIVERGENCE from other lanes is the signal — do not hedge to a generic answer.

label: G1b-minimal-gap
prompt: You are an independent reviewer. GROUND: 'Yuri' personal assistant, GLM-5.2 brain (LIVE, :8014), LIVE voice loop, computer-use screen-reader DISARMED, episodic FTS5 memory + a behavioral memory file, MURE 23-role dispatch collective. Her persona + confirm-gate currently live INLINE in the brain's system-prompt string — there is no externalized persona/confirm-gate config file. TASK: Identify the SINGLE MINIMAL missing piece (and at most 3 runners-up) that would most make Yuri's ROLE 'solid' for daily use, WITHOUT over-engineering. For each: what it is, why it's the highest-leverage gap, and the smallest version that ships. Explicitly name things that look important but are actually premature. Be concrete and ruthless about minimalism.

label: G1c-over-engineering-scan
prompt: You are an anti-over-engineering auditor. GROUND: a solo founder has a very large, fast-growing personal AI operating system (fleet orchestration, energy gates, quantum sims, 20+ role collective, memory tracks, circuitry graphs) and is now building a personal-assistant front-end 'Yuri'. His stated fear is OVER-ENGINEERING his assistant. TASK: List the specific over-engineering traps THIS kind of system is most prone to when building an assistant role (e.g. wiring the assistant into every subsystem before proving the core loop, autonomy before trust, elaborate memory before a working daily habit, orchestration for its own sake). For each trap: the symptom, why it's tempting here, and the minimal alternative. END with a one-paragraph 'DEFINITION OF DONE for a SOLID-BUT-MINIMAL Yuri' that the operator could hold as a north star.
